notes: The italic my answers to no suffix or other possessive morpheme in the clause, so it is added under rule 18's closing sentence and rule 30; rule 36 supplies only O, ye or thou to a vocative, never a possessive.
The construct musar carries no article morpheme, so its the is supplied on that noun under rule 29, while the rectum takes the chain's of and its own indefinite a (rules 19, 15).
The le before the infinitive construct takes the written to under rule 52 rather than going unrepresented.
